svg.font-family: Avenir Next, Avenir, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: OwlContinuity: the whole process in six steps
svg.desc: Animated: a closure notice reaches Instructor Desk; it finds the cancelled classes; the lab moves and the memo deadline fails the 48-hour rule; code rechecks the gaps and the memo moves to Tue Nov 3 as a draft; a student asks Student Helper a new question; the professor answers once and the next student gets answer A11.
svg.text: From a cancelled class to an approved answer · built in owlONE with gpt-6-luna

g.text: 1. The professor pastes the notice, the syllabus and their rules into Instructor Desk.
3 hits: two lessons and the lab
2. It finds every required class inside the closure: two lessons and the lab are cancelled.
3. The lab moves to Thu Oct 29, so the memo would be due only 26 h 10 m later. The domino.
4. Code rechecks every gap in New York time → UTC. The memo moves; the final stays. A draft.
"Can I send my professor a draft
of my memo early for feedback?"
"That's a new question. I won't guess."
No approved answer exists, so it drafts a message for the professor.
New question for the course FAQ: …
5. A question with no approved answer is never guessed. It becomes a tagged message.
The professor uploads the new bank file (manual today)
6. The professor answers once. It's added as A11, and the next student gets it right away.
